test_name: Player kill count shows 2.10K instead of 3K - f4a8ca8c-caf4-4931-930c-e991a783037f
summary: Passed because a player's kill label set to 2999 kills now reads 3.0K in game, where it used to read 2.10K. The shared number formatter rounded the digit after the dot on its own and never carried it into the whole number. It now rounds once and carries. 2900 still reads 2.9K and 1950 now reads 2.0K.
instructions:
TASK: [NXAB] bug with displaying the kills of a player

DESCRIPTION:
a player had 2.9K kills then when he was close to 3K it displayed 2.10K. cause:

in the file '`StringBuilderExtFormat.cs`' in the class '`StringBuilderExtensions`' we format each string with a way that rounds the number after the dot, which causes a number like 2999 to be rounded up to 2.10

REQUEST (from Amit):
@Big Sys investigate and fix

JOB TYPE:
BUG FIX - labeled 'Bug' and the description reports incorrect display of kill count (2.9K showing as 2.10K)

GAME MODE:
UNSURE - JUDE should decide from game context
verified: In play (Joint): the local mech's Mech ID 'Kills All Time' label, written through its TextTemplate with the same AppendFormat call as MPTotalKillsText.ToKM, shows 3.0K for 2999, 2.9K for 2900, 2.0K for 1950
not_done: MPAllTimeScoreText.ToK (BallTag stats) uses the same format and function - covered by the edit-mode check, not shown in play (same code path: ConcatFormat -> Concat(float, dp))
Live cage stats with 2999 kills from SpacetimeDB were not shown - shared DB is never written; the label was driven through its own TextTemplate with the production format call
999,950-999,999 kills now show 1000.0K (ToKM switches to M at 1,000,000) - previously 999.10K; threshold left unchanged
console_errors: UnityEngine.UnassignedReferenceException: The variable colliders of ColliderIgnoreGroup has not been assigned.
[Recorder] [UD Photon Voice Chat(Clone)] InputFactory creation failure: failed to getRecordDriverInfo: ERR_INVALID_PARAM.
